description: Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize network intelligence campaigns from initial hypothesis to validated performance improvements.

campaign_id.description: Unique identifier for a network intelligence campaign

segment_id.description: Identifier for a network or subscriber segment targeted by the campaign

metric_id.description: Identifier for a KPI or network metric

scenario_id.description: Identifier for a what-if simulation scenario

job_id.description: Identifier for an asynchronous processing or simulation job

experiment_id.description: Identifier for an A/B or multivariate experiment tied to a campaign

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a network change request generated from a campaign

functions.name: define_campaign_hypothesis
functions.description: Define a new network intelligence campaign with hypotheses, target segments, and success metrics.

description.description: Detailed description of the campaign intent

hypotheses.description: List of hypotheses to be validated in this campaign

target_metrics.description: Metrics that will be used to validate this hypothesis

target_segments.description: List of segment selectors to scope the campaign

definition.description: Definition of the segment when not using a pre-existing one

success_criteria.description: High-level success criteria for the entire campaign

guardrails.description: Metrics that must not degrade beyond thresholds

functions.returns: Newly created campaign with campaign_id, normalized hypotheses, and initial status.

functions.name: design_network_segments
functions.description: Create or refine reusable network segments for targeting within a campaign.

campaign_id.description: Campaign to associate the segments with

segment_id.description: Existing segment_id to update; omit to create new

time_window.description: Optional time constraint for this condition

dry_run.description: If true, only validate definitions without persisting

functions.returns: List of created/updated segments with segment_id, validation results, and any warnings.

functions.name: configure_kpis_and_baseline
functions.description: Configure KPIs to monitor in the campaign and compute baseline metrics for comparison.

items.description: Dimensions to group by (e.g., region, device_type)

segments.description: Optional subset of segment_ids to compute baselines for; defaults to all campaign segments

recompute.description: Recompute baseline even if it exists

functions.returns: Baseline metrics per KPI and segment, with metric_id, segment_id, baseline_value, and anomaly flags.

functions.name: run_traffic_simulation_scenario
functions.description: Create and execute a what-if simulation scenario to estimate campaign impact before activation.

scenario_id.description: Existing scenario to re-run or modify; omit for new

network_changes.description: Proposed parameter changes for the campaign

custom_filter.description: Optional custom selector when segment_id is not used

async.description: If true, run simulation asynchronously and return job_id

functions.returns: Simulation scenario with scenario_id, job_id if async, and either queued status or immediate results summary.

functions.name: get_simulation_status_and_results
functions.description: Check status and retrieve results for a traffic simulation job.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response

functions.returns: Simulation job status (queued, running, failed, completed) and, when completed, aggregated and per-segment results.

functions.name: activate_campaign
functions.description: Activate a validated campaign, including rollout strategy and safety checks.

min_improvement_delta.description: Minimum improvement in primary KPI to advance

pre_activation_checks.description: Controls for automated safety checks before activation

functions.returns: Activation result with updated campaign status, rollout_id, and any failed pre-activation checks.

functions.name: monitor_campaign_realtime
functions.description: Subscribe to and retrieve real-time monitoring view of campaign KPIs and alerts.

time_window.description: Time window relative to now for monitoring

filters.description: Additional filters for the monitoring view

subscription.description: Optional subscription configuration for streaming updates

functions.returns: Real-time snapshot of KPIs, active alerts, and subscription_id if streaming is configured.

functions.name: evaluate_campaign_performance
functions.description: Compute statistical lift, guardrail breaches, and overall success verdict for a campaign or experiment.

experiment_id.description: Optional experiment identifier for A/B or multivariate tests

evaluation_window.description: Evaluation time window; defaults to full active period

functions.returns: Performance summary including lift per KPI, p-values, confidence intervals, guardrail violations, and success verdict.

functions.name: propose_network_changes_from_campaign
functions.description: Generate a network change request based on evaluated campaign learnings.

target_scope.description: Scope of the resulting network change

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata for the change request

functions.returns: Draft change request with change_request_id, inferred changes, risk assessment, and required approvals.

functions.name: approve_or_reject_change_request
functions.description: Approve, reject, or request changes on a generated network change request.

actor.description: User or system performing the action

requested_modifications.description: Optional list of requested modifications when action is request_changes

functions.returns: Updated change request status, audit trail entry, and any pending approvals.

functions.name: pause_or_rollback_campaign
functions.description: Pause an active campaign or roll back applied changes in case of issues.

rollback_scope.description: Scope of rollback when action is rollback

functions.returns: Updated campaign state, rollback job_id if applicable, and summary of segments affected.

functions.name: retry_failed_simulation_or_rollout
functions.description: Retry failed simulation jobs or rollout phases with optional parameter adjustments.

job_id.description: ID of the failed job to retry

adjustments.description: Optional parameter adjustments for the retry

ignore_previous_errors.description: Error codes that can be ignored on retry

functions.returns: New job_id for the retry, updated job status, and a summary of applied adjustments.

functions.name: list_and_get_campaigns
functions.description: List campaigns with filters and retrieve detailed information for a specific campaign.

campaign_id.description: If provided, returns details for this campaign_id

functions.returns: If campaign_id is provided, detailed campaign object; otherwise, a paginated list of campaigns with summary fields.

functions.name: get_campaign_status_and_timeline
functions.description: Get current status and historical timeline of key events for a campaign.
functions.returns: Campaign status (lifecycle + rollout phase), plus ordered timeline of events with timestamps and metadata.

functions.name: search_campaigns
functions.description: Faceted search across network insight campaigns with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of network insight campaign summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_campaigns
functions.description: Create multiple network insight campaigns in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created network insight campaign ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_campaigns
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many network insight campaigns with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each network insight campaign, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_campaigns
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many network insight campaigns in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each network insight campaign, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_campaigns
functions.description: Export network insight campaign datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_campaigns
functions.description: Bulk-import network insight campaign records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated network insight campaigns.

functions.name: subscribe_to_campaign_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive network insight campaign lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the network insight campaign.

functions.name: get_campaign_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a network insight campaign, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the network insight campaign, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_campaign_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for network insight campaigns using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the network insight campaign action.

functions.name: simulate_campaign_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a network insight campaign without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the network insight campaign, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_campaign_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a network insight campaign change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the network insight campaign under change.

functions.name: decide_campaign_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending network insight campaign approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the network insight campaign.

functions.name: add_campaign_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a network insight campaign for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the network insight campaign.

functions.name: upload_campaign_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a network insight campaign with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the network insight campaign.

functions.name: create_campaign_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a network insight campaign (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the network insight campaign version captured.

functions.name: restore_campaign_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a network insight campaign from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the network insight campaign.

functions.name: get_campaign_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for network insight campaigns over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the network insight campaign domain context.

functions.name: get_campaign_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for network insight campaigns combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the network insight campaign context.

functions.name: create_campaign_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to network insight campaigns with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current network insight campaigns.

functions.name: evaluate_campaign_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a network insight campaign in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the network insight campaign.

functions.name: get_campaign_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a network insight campaign including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the network insight campaign, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_campaign_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a network insight campaign and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the network insight campaign.

functions.name: assign_campaign_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a network insight campaign with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the network insight campaign with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_campaigns
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more network insight campaigns, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each network insight campaign.

functions.name: compare_campaign_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a network insight campaign with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the network insight campaign, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_campaign_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to network insight campaign operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of network insight campaign operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_campaign_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a network insight campaign and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the network insight campaign, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_campaign
functions.description: Clone a network insight campaign into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned network insight campaign record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_campaign_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted network insight campaign report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the network insight campaign window covered.

functions.name: escalate_campaign
functions.description: Escalate a network insight campaign to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the network insight campaign.
